title: Cardinal UI dashboard spec
description: The spec object accepted by Import from JSON and by POST/PUT /api/orgs/{orgId}/dashboards. See https://docs.cardinalhq.io/ui/dashboards/json-spec.

category.description: Where the dashboard is listed on the Dashboards page. Omitted or unknown means Custom.

libraryRef.description: Set on dashboards added from the gallery. While it is set, Cardinal UI shows the gallery's version instead of this spec. Delete it before creating a dashboard from an exported spec; updates and Import from JSON remove it for you.

duration.description: Default time window when the dashboard opens, e.g. "1h", "24h", "7d".

sections.description: Ordered list of sections holding the grid layout.

variables.description: Dashboard variables whose selected values are substituted into queries.

smooth.description: Apply a display-only moving average to time-series panels. Default false.

sharedCrosshair.description: Hovering a time on one chart draws a line at the same time on every other time-axis chart. Default true.

Dashboard.description: A Cardinal UI dashboard spec: the object accepted by Import from JSON and by POST/PUT /api/orgs/{orgId}/dashboards.

Panel.description: One dashboard panel. The kind field selects the panel type.

yAxisLabel.description: Y-axis title. Drawn as "Title (unit)" when unit is also set.

xAxisLabel.description: X-axis title, drawn under the time ticks.

id.description: Panel id, unique within the dashboard. Use the same value as its key in panels.

description.description: Markdown help text shown behind a ? icon next to the title.

queries.description: Queries that feed the panel. Use [] for panel kinds that don't query.

interlinks.description: Click-through links from a series to another dashboard.

unit.description: Unit shown on the Y axis, e.g. "ms", "%", "req/s".

yMin.description: Fixed lower bound for the Y axis.

yMax.description: Fixed upper bound for the Y axis.

integerYMax.description: Round the top of the Y axis up to a whole number.

highlightWhen.description: Shade the background wherever a second query is above a threshold.

smooth.description: Per-panel override of the dashboard-level smooth setting.

TimeSeriesPanel.description: Line, area or bar chart over time.

query.description: PromQL (default) or LogQL expression. $variable and ${variable} are substituted from dashboard variables.

name.description: Legend name for returned series. {{label}} inserts a label value.

includePartialStep.description: Include the final, still-filling time bucket.

color.description: Fixed hex color for this query's series.

formulaSource.description: Set by the panel editor when the query came from a formula. Not needed when writing specs by hand.

hidden.description: Keep the query in the spec without plotting it.

label.description: Menu label. {{label}} inserts a value from the clicked series.

targetDashboardId.description: Id of the dashboard to open.

entityKind.description: Optional grouping hint for the link menu.

requiredLabels.description: Labels the clicked series must have for the link to appear.

paramMap.description: Target variable name mapped to the source series label that fills it.

keepTimeRange.description: Keep the current time range on the target dashboard. Default true.

group.description: Optional section header in the link menu.

PanelInterlink.description: A link from a clicked series to another dashboard.

query.description: PromQL or LogQL query. Group by a label to get one band per value.

threshold.description: A sample above this value is shaded. Default 0.5.

colors.description: Band color per series label value.

defaultColor.description: Band color for label values not listed in colors.

PanelHighlightWhen.description: Background shading driven by a threshold query.

sparkline.description: Draw the series as a small trend line under the number.

id.description: Panel id, unique within the dashboard. Use the same value as its key in panels.

description.description: Markdown help text shown behind a ? icon next to the title.

queries.description: Queries that feed the panel. Use [] for panel kinds that don't query.

calculation.description: How the series is reduced to one number. Default last.

format.description: Number formatting: unit suffix and decimal places.

xAxisLabel.description: X-axis title, drawn under the time ticks.

serviceName.description: Center the graph on this service. A $variable works here.

maxHops.description: How far out from serviceName to draw. Default 3.

ServiceGraphPanel.description: Service dependency graph built from traces. Use queries: [].

id.description: Panel id, unique within the dashboard. Use the same value as its key in panels.

description.description: Markdown help text shown behind a ? icon next to the title.

queries.description: Queries that feed the panel. Use [] for panel kinds that don't query.

interlinks.description: Click-through links from a series to another dashboard.

distributionOnly.description: Show only the per-service severity chart, without log lines.

logqlState.description: Logs Explore builder state. Easiest to get from an exported dashboard.

limit.description: Maximum number of log lines. Default 100.

LogEventsPanel.description: Log lines with a volume chart. Use queries: [] and set rawLogql or logqlState.

cells.description: Grid positions of the panels in this section.

rowHeight.description: Fixed pixel height per row unit. Omit to fit the viewport.

DashboardSection.description: A collapsible section of the dashboard grid.

i.description: Id of the panel in this cell.

GridCell.description: A panel's position on the 24-column grid.

name.description: Token used in queries. Letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.

label.description: Text above the picker. Defaults to name.

source.description: Where the picker's options come from.

multi.description: Allow several values. They are substituted as a regex alternation; match with =~.

includeAll.description: With multi, offer an All option, substituted as .+.

regex.description: Hide options that don't match this regex.

DashboardVariable.description: A dashboard variable. Its selected values replace $name in queries.

scope.description: Extra label matchers that limit the options by another variable, e.g. cluster=~"$cluster".

expr.description: Optional LogQL selector that limits the options.

VariableQuerySource.description: Metrics: values of a label on a metric. Logs: values of a log label.
